paite: Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat avaihawm kum in Judahte tung ah Abijah in vai ahawm pan hi.
heading: Jeroboam Toh Abijah Kidouna / (1 Kum 15.1-8)

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ahawm a, anu min Mikaiah, Gibeah mi Uriel tanu ahi. Huan Abijah leh Jeroboam bel akidou uhi.
Abijah in sepaih kidoumi, mihangsan telkhiak nuaili toh ava sual a, Jeroboam mihat hangsan telkhiak nuaigiat kiphalh in ana dou uhi.
Abijah bel Ephraim tanggam a om Zemariam tang tung ah adingh a, "Aw Jeroboam, Israelte tengteng toh na ngaikhia un;
TOUPA Israel' Pathian in Israel gam David leh atate kiang a chi a thukhun in tangtawn a ding in apia chih thei dia kilawm mahmah hilou na hi uh maw?
Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam, David tapa Solomon sikha apu tung ah ahong hel maimah hi.
Rehoboam anaupang lai a, alungsim anem lai a, amaute ana nan theih louh lai in Solomon tapa Rehoboam kalh in mithulim lou Belial tate akikaikhawm uhi.
"David tapa lak ah TOUPA gam dou theih na kigingta kei ua: tamkuam leng hi ua, Jeroboam in pathiante ding a nou ahon bawlsak dangka-eng bawngnou limte leng na kiang uah a-om lai hi.

TOUPA siampu, Aaron tapate leh Levite delhkhia in, gamdang mite hihdan bang in siampu na kibawl uh ahi kei maw? Huchi in bawngtuai leh belam sagih a hong kilan peuhmahte pathian hiloupite siampu ahi thei zel mawk uhi.
"Himahleh kou zaw, ka Pathian uh TOUPA ahi a, amah ka lehngatsan kei ua: TOUPA a dia nasemmi amau nna chiat sem Aaron tapa siampute leh Levite ka nei uhi.

Ni teng leh zan teng in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte, gimlimte ahal zel uh, tanghou siah leng dohkan siangthou ah akoih kichian gige uhi. Nitaklam teng a hal ding in dangka-eng khawnvak koihna akhawnvak toh; kou zaw TOUPA ka Pathian uh thupiak ka zui gige ua, nou bel amah na lehngatsan uhi.

Ngai dih ua, Pathian ka ma uh pi in ka kiang uah a-om a, asiampute leng apengkul ua nou hon noh ding a mut ding in a-om uhi. Aw, Israel suante aw TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian zaw dou mahmah kei un, na lamzang kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
Himahleh Jeroboam in anunglam uah aguktansak a: huchi in Judahte malam ah a-om ua, guktan mite anunglam uah a-om uh.
Judahte alehngat uleh anunglam uh leh amalam uah gal a-omta a, TOUPA asam ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi.
Huchi in Judahte akikou zuazua ua; huchi a Judahte akikou zuazua ualeh hichi ahong hi a, Abijah leh Judahte ma ah TOUPA'N Jeroboam leh Israelte tengteng avuallelsakta hi.
Israel suante Judahte ma ah ataikek ua, Pathian in akhut uah apeta hi.
Huchi in Abijah leh aheute'n amau athat ua: Israel mitel ngen nuainga athat uhi.
Huai tung in Israel suante vuallelhdan huchibang ahi, Judah suante'n TOUPA apipute uh Pathian amuan ziak un azouta uhi.
Huan Abijah in Jeroboam adelh a, akhuate alaksak a, Bethel akhotate toh, Jeshanah akhotate toh, Ephron akhotate toh.
Abijah vaihawm lai nite in Jeroboam in dinkhiak zohna anei nawn kei; TOUPA'N agawt a, asita hi.
Abijah bel ahat deuhdeuh a, zi sawm-le-li anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-nih leh tanu sawm-le-guk anei hi.
Abijah tanchin dangte leh a-omdante, athugente zawlnei Iddo hilhchetna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
